pipelines.description: Stress tests arguments through adversarial probing, boundary testing, and robustness evaluation
Comprehensive argument structure analysis - maps logical architecture, excavates assumptions, detects rhetorical maneuvers, and steelmans positions
Identifies causal relationships, counterfactuals, competing explanations, and explanatory patterns
Performs thematic synthesis, comparative analysis, cross-cultural variation, and interdisciplinary connections
Comprehensive concept analysis using multiple philosophical lenses - centrality mapping, evolution tracking, affordance analysis, and demarcation
Multi-stage critical analysis: argument structure, then epistemological scrutiny, then institutional power analysis
Analyzes market dynamics, financial flows, policy impacts, and economic positioning
Identifies epistemic weaknesses - unearned certainty, false profundity, calibration failures, and stance inconsistencies
Evaluates the quality, reliability, and triangulation of evidence and data sources
Analyzes temporal dynamics - timelines, cycles, discontinuities, periodization, and path dependencies
Analyzes organizational dynamics, incentive structures, principal-agent problems, and institutional pathologies
Evaluates research methodology - confounds, selection bias, sample issues, measurement validity, replication status
Excavates conceptual conditions, paradigmatic assumptions, absent centers, and foundational frameworks
Maps power dynamics, stakeholder interests, resource flows, and institutional capture patterns
Analyzes persuasive techniques, amplification patterns, metaphorical structures, and rhetorical strategies
Maps academic debates, citation networks, intellectual lineages, and paradigm conflicts
Scenario planning, early warning detection, opportunity-vulnerability mapping, and escalation trajectory analysis
Analyzes complex systems - feedback loops, emergence, leverage points, boundaries, and unintended consequences
Detects emerging trends, conceptual anomalies, literature gaps, and contrarian patterns
